title: Fenridge Fabrication LLC v. Rillhaven Exhibit Studio LLC
forum: Hennepin County District Court (contract suit); U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota (related copyright suit)

parties.name: Rillhaven Exhibit Studio LLC
parties.role: Client; state defendant and federal plaintiff

parties.name: Tamarfen Exhibits LLC
parties.role: Defendant in related federal copyright suit

timeline.event: Exhibit artwork licensed to fabricator for a single traveling display
Rival unveiled a nearly identical upside-down forest exhibit
Client filed a related federal copyright suit against the rival; pleadings later closed
Fabricator personally served client with Hennepin County summons and contract complaint
Rival mailed its first interrogatories in the federal suit
Client workplan signed; draft delivery agreed for ten days after reset

documents.title: State summons and complaint
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Fenridge Fabrication seeks the unpaid balance for the upside-down forest display. Rillhaven Exhibit Studio says the hanging platforms arrived warped. Summons personally served eight days before reset; ordinary Minnesota answer period, no extension or prior motion.

documents.title: Federal interrogatories and mailing certificate
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Tamarfen Exhibits asks who created each lantern-leaf drawing and who had access to the source files. Its certificate states service by U.S. mail five days before reset in the separate District of Minnesota copyright case; no stipulation changes the response period.

documents.title: Agreed workplan
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Workplan § 2: Counsel will deliver the state answer draft and a federal discovery response outline to the client. Delivery is due ten calendar days after the demo reset date. This is an agreed draft-delivery milestone, separate from any filing deadline.

deadlines.label: Respond to federal interrogatories served by mail

trigger.event: First interrogatories served by U.S. mail in related federal case

deadlines.label: Agreed delivery of answer and discovery drafts

clientFacing.status: Two related disputes are moving at once: the builder wants payment, and a rival has asked questions about your artwork.
nextSteps: Send photographs of the warped platforms and the original lantern-leaf drawings.
We will prepare the state answer and draft federal discovery responses for your review.
